items.headline: Microsoft jumps 7% as it boosts capital spending plans, citing demand

items.headline: Chipotle hikes same-store sales forecast, says cyclospora fears hit sales in late July
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill stock has fallen more than 7% this year, dragging its market value down to roughly $44 billion.

items.headline: Alphabet Stock: Selloff Misses Bigger Story (NASDAQ:GOOGL)

items.summary: Gundlach said the divergent moves across the Treasury curve showed investors' skepticism that the Fed will ultimately follow through.

items.headline: Carvana stock falls as auto retailer’s 2026 earnings guidance misses Wall Street’s expectations
items.summary: Carvana said Wednesday it expects earnings of between $2.7 billion and $3 billion this year after reporting record quarterly results for the second quarter.

items.headline: Here are the last times the Dow dropped by 1,000 points and what happened next
items.summary: After the Dow falls by 1,000 points, the index typically is weak in the week that follows. The average then posts gains in the next month and three months.

items.headline: Todd Blanche attorney general nomination on edge as Cornyn questions Trump-IRS settlement
items.summary: Sen. John Cornyn says the DOJ has failed to satisfy his concerns about a deal to shield President Donald Trump and others from IRS tax audits.

items.headline: Starbucks stock jumps as coffee giant raises full-year outlook
items.summary: Starbucks posted its fourth straight quarter of same-store sales growth, as it continues a turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.

items.summary: "Cost went up, prices are going to go up," Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said in an interview.

items.headline: Sam Altman to meet with White House's Wiles this week ahead of AI framework deadline
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is meeting with a range of senior Trump administration officials, lawmakers and economists.

items.headline: Hims and Hers shares fall 10% as FTC sues company over data, billing practices
items.summary: The FTC sued Hims and Hers over alleged health data sharing with Meta and Snap, billing practices and subscription cancellations.

items.headline: Secret Service 'illegally' surveilled Comey in Trump ‘8647’ threat case: Court filing
items.summary: Ex-FBI Director James Comey says he's the subject of vindictive prosecution for posting on Instagram a photo of seashells forming the numbers "8647."
